exposure: Implementation of a Group B Streptococcal (GBS) dynamic order set
outcome: Appropriate treatment of preterm patients (positive and unknown GBS)
Appropriate use of clindamycin and vancomycin
Clindamycin use in those without sensitivity testing
cohort: The study participants were patients delivering at a single high-volume obstetric unit and five additional hospitals within a region of a large health system, before and after the implementation of a GBS dynamic order set.
finding: The routine universal use of a dynamic admission labor/induction order set was associated with high and improved adherence to GBS prophylaxis guidelines.
gest_age: Preterm delivery occurred in 6.8% and 6.9% of the groups, indicating that preterm patients were included and their treatment was an outcome of interest.
